LESSON 11 / 27 • ORIGINAL CHECKLIST
id vs class
An id should uniquely identify an element in a document; classes are reusable labels for groups
id එක page එකකේ තුළ unique Jවන්න ඕJන්. class එක elements කිහිපයකටම දාන්න පුළුවන්.
A single checkout form contains several styled buttons.
Read the numbered stages from top to bottom. #checkout → one element; CSS / JS → select targets.

<form id="checkout">
 <button class="action">Pay</button>
 <button class="action" type="reset">Reset</button>
</form>
<style>
 #checkout { padding: 1rem; }
 .action { color: navy; }
</style>
Expected result: Both buttons receive class styling; the form receives id styling.
Interview question: Can two elements share the same id?
Answer: They should not; duplicate IDs make references and selection unreliable.
Practice: Style two cards with the same class and different IDs.
